The graph's active narrative (Narrative_ContentDerivedSlugResolution) and its unplaced position (Position_SubmissionWithoutExplicitIdHandling) are the exact frame this document extends: both ask how the pipeline handles omitted identifiers and commits content. I did not expand the DiagnosticFirst decision or the People/Unplaced doors because they concern engagement methodology and actor identity, not the slug-derivation pipeline behavior this document tests.
